summary: Public route entry contract for the website-first path after step 39. The current public entry is stable because it still loads the full existing social-app runtime, but that also means social-app remains the real public startup blocker. A separate lightweight Public/Profile/Menu entry is not safe to attach yet because the synchronous public renderer still owns menu, focus, product detail, cart, QR context, and profile surfaces together. This step records the contract and applies only a safe public-entry load alignment plus a bundle budget guard.
currentPublicStartupPath: entry/social-app.js imports preload-helper and vendor-firebase and initializes the existing app runtime

mustKeep: profile open state and back behavior
menu public item load and cache
focus truth coordination before menu content appears
shop cart state, variants, comments, totals
QR/table access source and table number context
cart/order receive the same restaurant and table context

whySafe: The full existing social-app runtime is still loaded.
No renderer, route, Firebase path, query, payload, CSS, DOM ID, or class changed.
The raw public entry already uses the non-awaited load pattern.
The public entry still sets the same public globals and degraded-state handling.

guards: entry/social-app.js size must stay under the post-step-39 budget
profile-open-flow-utils.js must remain a social-app dynamic import
chat-app-runtime-lazy-facade.js must remain a social-app dynamic import
discovery, orders, menu modal, profile open flow, and chat facade must not become static social-app imports again
public entry must keep social-app as a dynamic import
public entry must not reintroduce top-level await for the social-app import

rejectedForNow.candidate: Attach a lightweight publicBusiness/publicMenu renderer immediately
rejectedForNow.reason: profile-menu-focus-render-controller.js is still the synchronous source of truth for public profile, menu, focus, cart/favorites, own profile, and menu admin rendering. Splitting it now risks missing visible behavior.

rejectedForNow.candidate: Stop loading social-app.js from public entry
rejectedForNow.reason: Not safe until the public route renderer contract is implemented and manually verified for menu, focus, product detail, cart, checkout, QR/table context, and profile interactions.

nextSafeImplementationCandidate.name: Public route render contract extraction
nextSafeImplementationCandidate.description: Create a public route runtime that still calls existing source-of-truth renderers, then manually verify /casarita and /casarita/menu before allowing social-app.js to stop being an immediate public startup dependency.
prerequisites: Manual smartphone test of current /casarita/menu with fresh bundle
Explicit confirmation that menu, focus, product detail, cart, checkout, order, and QR/table context are unchanged
No direct public route renderer replacement until fallback is proven
